long_description.before:
WeWeb is a visual programming tool that allows you to build user interfaces on top of existing databases & auth systems. It allies the short learning curve of no-code with the freedom of code.

CONTROL & FREEDOM – Build pixel-perfect frontends with drag-and-drop UI elements and no-code CSS properties but have the option to add custom code or import your own Vue.js components.

CODE BEST PRACTICES – Follow development best practices by building components, global workflows and re-usable functions with no-code triggers and formulas with the option to add custom JS where needed.  

NO VENDOR LOCK-IN – WeWeb generates a standard PWA-ready Single Page Application and allows you to deploy your projects on your own infrastructure. Build in no-code, host on-premise.
long_description.after: WeWeb is an AI platform for building secure, scalable full-stack applications without writing code. Business teams can build and iterate autonomously, connect the tools they already use through native integrations, and move from idea to production quickly, without waiting on engineering resources. Built-in safeguards give technical leaders confidence that speed doesn’t come at the expense of security, quality, or control.

one_liner.before: WeWeb is a no-code front-end builder that connects with any back-end.
one_liner.after: WeWeb is the AI app builder your IT team will approve.

long_description.after:
Drama Drama is building the monetization platform for AI character and drama creators.

Creators are already building AI characters and serialized stories that attract audiences on TikTok, Instagram, YouTube and other social platforms, but turning that fandom into direct revenue is still difficult.

Drama Drama lets creators monetize their existing characters and series through gated episodes, paid AI character chat across text, voice and video, personalized fan experiences and other direct-to-fan products.

Creators can bring the content and audience they already have. For selected creators who want help producing a series, we also offer optional co-production.

one_liner.after: Monetization platform for AI characters and dramas

long_description.before:
Our mission: cure diabetes, and help every person with diabetes stay healthy until we do.

GloGlo is building a new consumer health brand for diabetics and the glucose-conscious.

Our first products are the GloGlo AI glucose companion, which turns continuous glucose data into personalized insights and practical guidance, and GloGlo Energy Gummies, a fast, convenient, and enjoyable source of glucose for exercise, daily energy, and managing lows.
long_description.after:
Our mission: eradicate type 1 diabetes.
GloGlo is building an AI-native therapeutics company focused on accelerating the discovery of treatments that can prevent, stop, and ultimately cure type 1 diabetes.
We are developing AI research agents that continuously analyze scientific literature and biological datasets, generate and challenge hypotheses, design experiments, and run them in a wet lab to learn from experimental results.
We are building a tight "in silico <> in vitro/vivo" feedback loop that helps us identify better targets, run experiments more efficiently, and move faster toward therapies for type 1 diabetes.
